meta.name: discover
meta.description: Trace a customer workflow and identify the problem, baseline and evidence gaps. Use for discovery or an unclear customer brief, before choosing a solution.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把模糊的客户需求理成清楚的问题、基线与证据清单
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果客户只丢来一句模糊需求,还没想清到底要解决什么。
copy.tagline_en: Turn a vague customer brief into a clear problem, baseline and evidence list
copy.fit_line_en: For you if a customer brief is vague and you must pin down the real problem first.

howto.what: Claude 会先读任务上下文契约和方法参考,再沿客户工作流逐步追踪,输出问题、基线与证据缺口的记录,而不是直接给方案。
howto.when: 当任务是 discovery、客户简报不清楚,或在选方案之前时接管;被 @fde 调用时复用其已脱敏的上下文与范围。

say.text: 帮我梳理这个客户的工作流,找出问题和证据缺口
say.note: 按方法逐步追踪并记录未知项

say.text: 这份客户简报我看不太懂,先做一轮 discovery
say.note: 输出问题、基线与证据缺口

howto.what_en: Claude reads the task context contract and method, then traces a customer workflow step by step and reports the problem, baseline and evidence gaps instead of jumping to a solution.
howto.when_en: Triggers for discovery work, an unclear customer brief, or before choosing a solution; when called by @fde it reuses that run's sanitized packet and scope.

say_en.text: Walk me through this customer's workflow and flag the problem and evidence gaps.
say_en.note: Traces step by step; records unknowns.

say_en.text: This customer brief is unclear - run a discovery pass first.
